new_description: Hull plate of uridium alloy, a staple of Cardassian shipbuilding. Plain, in the ochre of the Union's fleets, and sound enough to bring a ship home. Gives almost no protection against fire; it is there to soak up damage. Of the Cardassian ship plates of its size, it is the cheapest to build and the easiest to repair, but the most fragile.

A laminate rolled out in bulk at the orbital assembly yards above Cardassia Prime. There is always more of it. Some protection against explosions. Of the Cardassian ship plates of its size, it is the lightest and the easiest to repair, but the weakest against beams.

Ceramic fired from the by-products of uridite ore, refined by the Union at stations like Terok Nor. The Union can turn it out in vast numbers. Some protection against kinetic rounds and explosions. Of the Cardassian ship plates of its size, it is the weakest against beams.

Uridium alloy bonded in layers with other metals. The Union cannot afford to waste ships, so the plate is made to keep them alive. Good protection against explosions, some protection against kinetic rounds. Of the Cardassian ship plates of its size, it is the weakest against beams.

Crystal lattice plating, dark as obsidian, developed in the Obsidian Order's own laboratories. Its makers will not say how it works, only that it does. Good protection against explosions, some protection against kinetic rounds. Of the Cardassian ship plates of its size, it is the best protected against kinetic rounds and the best protected against explosions, but the costliest to build.

Ablative plate that burns away in layers, so the first hits fall on plating and not on the crew. The Union has plenty of plate and fewer ships than it needs. Some protection against kinetic rounds, beams, energy fire and explosions. Of the Cardassian ship plates of its size, it is the toughest and the best protected against beams, but the heaviest.

Ablative plating for the ring and pylons of a Nor-style station, whose pylons are packed with ore processing plant. Replaced after every siege. Strong protection against kinetic rounds, beams, energy fire and explosions, good protection against plasma. Of the Cardassian orbital plates of its size, it is the toughest and the best protected against beams, but the heaviest.

Living plate regrown from reclaimed waste. A people short of resources learn to waste nothing, armour included. Strong protection against every kind of fire. Of the Cardassian orbital plates of its size, it is the lightest.

Crystal grown through a living scaffold from reclaimed material, which seals cracks as they open. Strong protection against every kind of fire. Of the Cardassian orbital plates of its size, it is the lightest and the best protected against plasma, but the costliest to build.

Polarised plating for a station's habitat ring, tuned to bleed off energy fire and built to hold through a long siege. Some protection against kinetic rounds and explosions. Of the Cardassian orbital plates of its size, it is the cheapest to build and the easiest to repair, but the most fragile.
